eval.title: Micron Stock Analysis - Good, but not great yet!

call.headline_quote: in my opinion it's not a great buy it's a good one

base_metric.name: fcf_per_share
base_metric.quote: even if they make a hundred billion which is also a stretch then we are at 10 billion in free cash flows

scenarios.name: normal
scenarios.quote: if they make 10 billion by 2030 fee ratio of 12 because the market will always think it is cyclical because it is that's a 10 return per year

scenarios.name: worst
scenarios.quote: if they make 75 billion that's 7.5 billion in free cash flows that really changes the valuation down the road

what_is_priced_in.quote: the p ratio isn't 10 anymore because there will be no profitability in q1 and down the road as they expect

reasons.claim: Even assuming $100B revenue and a 10% FCF margin, Micron only produces $10B free cash flow, giving a modest ~10% return at a 12x multiple, so it is a good buy but not a great one.
reasons.quote: if they make 10 billion by 2030 fee ratio of 12 because the market will always think it is cyclical because it is that's a 10 return per year

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: fcf margin assumption, terminal pe, expected return

reasons.claim: Micron is a fully cyclical business with brutal margin swings, and current high inventories suggest the downturn could last longer, so buying should be staggered as the price falls.
reasons.quote: yes it is 100 cyclical even if the last two years yes this time is different but as I always said it's never different so q1 revenues down 49 47 and an absolute destruction in margins from 48 to 23

data_check.gap_note: he says 0.49, as-of 0.110197 (FY2022); annual vs TTM or a different definition; not in our data: margin decline

reasons.claim: Consolidation from twelve to three players could allow the industry to shift from a low-margin commodity business into a higher-margin, higher-cash-flow oligopoly over time.
reasons.quote: so free players oligopoly so he thinks that now that there are just three players down from 12 a decade ago that there will be improved profits and improved margins

reasons.claim: Samsung's continued heavy capex investment despite the downturn threatens the oligopoly discipline thesis and could prolong the price cycle for everyone.
reasons.quote: Samsung said I'm going to keep my investments because I want to gain market share

data_check.gap_note: he says 8.9e+10, as-of 8.262e+09 (FY2022); annual vs TTM or a different definition

reasons.claim: The stock is trading close to tangible book value, historically the point at which Micron has bottomed and been a good time to buy in a cyclical strategy.
reasons.quote: the best time to buy more is when it comes close to tangible Book value so this won't grow likely go a little bit lower so around 40 bucks per share from the current closer to 60

data_check.gap_note: not in our data: book value estimate

external_facts_used: Monish Pabrai's public commentary and thesis on Micron
13F-style holdings/purchase history of Pabrai, Li Lu, Seth Klarman
Samsung's $89 billion cash balance and capex guidance
Micron CEO commentary on industry supply/demand imbalance
Micron investor day projections of $330 billion market by year

critic.notes: Reason 5 claims the stock trades close to tangible book; transcript says "now not yet so close to book" and expects a drop to ~$40 from ~$60 before it becomes the best buy.
